name: ft-authz-negative-anon-split
description: R210 P2 (security plan section 2 / section 5): the SPLIT re-run for ft-authz-negative-anon. Run 2 (batch5, after the equals-to-contains asset fix) passed 27/29 with ONLY doors 13-14 (steps 26-27, users-verify + users-bulk-action) 429-blocked - the 11th + 12th POSTs vs the shared 10/h ip:unknown api-post bucket (the rate limiter working as designed; the split re-run covers the two doors). This split runs ONLY those 2 doors against a fresh dev restart: an ANONYMOUS visitor (no sign-in) probes both POST admin doors with a freshly minted public CSRF token so the ROLE gate answers - every door must refuse with 401. The 27 passed steps are NOT re-run - their receipts live in the batch5 devlog + the main scenario receipt.

steps.name: admin-door-13-users-verify-401-with-csrf
steps.expr: (() => { const c = new XMLHttpRequest(); c.open('GET', '/api/auth/csrf', false); c.send(); const t = (JSON.parse(c.responseText) || {}).csrfToken || ''; const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('POST', '/api/admin/users/u_seller1/verify', false); x.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json'); x.setRequestHeader('X-CSRF-Token', t); x.send(JSON.stringify({ grant: true })); return 'csrf=' + (t ? 'ok' : 'none') + ' status=' + x.status + ' body=' + x.responseText.substring(0, 120) })()

steps.name: admin-door-14-users-bulk-action-401-with-csrf
steps.expr: (() => { const c = new XMLHttpRequest(); c.open('GET', '/api/auth/csrf', false); c.send(); const t = (JSON.parse(c.responseText) || {}).csrfToken || ''; const x = new XMLHttpRequest(); x.open('POST', '/api/admin/users/bulk-action', false); x.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json'); x.setRequestHeader('X-CSRF-Token', t); x.send(JSON.stringify({ userIds: ['u_seller1'], action: 'approve' })); return 'csrf=' + (t ? 'ok' : 'none') + ' status=' + x.status + ' body=' + x.responseText.substring(0, 120) })()
